A '''sturdy leather helmet''' is the [[Sturdy leather armor|sturdy leather]] [[Armor#Helmet|helmet]], crafted from 5 [[sturdy leather]]. Sturdy leather armor is a light set built against arrows and falls.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

=== Chest loot ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===
It gives 2 armor with 350 durability and 2 blocks of safe fall distance, twice what leather gives. Projectile Protection III comes on the item as an ordinary enchantment.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[tattered leather]]. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].
